purpose.quoted: Forward signal tracking only. Each entry is a frozen fast/slow oscillator rule gated by a recent regular divergence on the SLOW oscillator. Emitting BUY/SELL records an observation; it is not a recommendation and carries no order authority.

knownLimitations.quoted: The double-positive rate across the campaign (16/437 = 3.7%) exceeds the independence expectation (2.4%) only modestly; this set is NOT established as distinguishable from search noise.
Of 75 cells that passed holdout, only 21.3% stayed positive on confirmation, against a 14.2% marginal rate.
Cells are not independent: adjacent timeframes share signals, and ta_stochastic and ta_williams_r rows appear numerically identical in several cases.
No shifted-label or permutation null has been run against these survivors.
The retrospective confirmation window ends 2026-08-01, so tracking after that date is genuinely unseen data. That is the purpose of this registry.

reason.quoted: Deferred by human decision. The OIL cells require Databento CL continuous futures with the contract-roll handling the frozen protocol mandates (protocol.frozen.json -> futures.roll_policy: "force flat and reset adapter/divergence/evaluator state"), implemented by RollResetAdapter and RollResetLifecycleEvaluator. The candle data exists (data/databento-futures/cl/1min/); the roll-reset evaluation path is what is missing. No adapter is instantiated and no signal is produced for these cells. Their warmup_bars_required values (156 and 124) are reproducible from the frozen adapter, so a later OIL build has a checkable target.
